name: Grey Art Gallery
notes: Grey Art Gallery (now the Grey Art Museum) in NYU's Main Building, the Silver Center, on Washington Square East, where the gallery held the ground floor until 2023: a tall block (the ground file gives about fifteen storeys) between Washington Place and Waverly Place, with a stone base, a shaft of buff brick and limestone with paired windows, round-arched top storeys and a cornice; the gallery's large street windows facing Washington Square Park across the street. Turned 29 degrees to the Manhattan grid. Written from general knowledge; guessed: the height, the window rhythm, the arcade at the top, the neighbour. No photographs were available.
